coordinator.narrative: Calderune should issue a flood warning for 2026-07-04, when the complete combined inflow is projected at exactly 44475 m3/s, above the 44,000 m3/s threshold and providing about one day of lead time. No single nation could identify this regional threat because each assessed only its own river, all remained below local danger levels with no local alerts, and the flood risk emerges only when the five rivers converge. On the warning date, the largest contribution is from Brenholt (23244 m3/s), followed by Torvia (6940 m3/s), Kaldor (6709 m3/s), Ostmark (4312 m3/s), and Veyra (3270 m3/s). The 2026-07-05 projection is 38510 m3/s, but it is only a lower bound because Ostmark is not yet reporting for that arrival date; later dates are also incomplete and cannot be treated as safe.
coordinator.recommendation: Calderune should immediately activate its flood-warning protocol for July 4, coordinate protective actions and evacuation readiness in low-lying delta communities, and request updated arrival-date projections from all five upstream nations.
